D: A rock star's whole wild life story, from a farm in Alabama to the top of the charts and back.
P: Serve the mains when Dewey makes it big.
S: Soft salty boiled peanuts in the shell, a Southern porch snack. Simmer 500g raw peanuts in the shell in 3L water with 80g salt for 3 hours until soft.
Dewey's first gigs in the fifties
Crisp shoestring fries smothered in melted cheddar sauce and spring onion, a diner basket from Dewey's early days on the road.
M: Buttermilk fried chicken with mashed potatoes and gravy, Southern Sunday cooking. Soak 1.2kg chicken pieces in 300ml buttermilk overnight.
W: Spiced sweet potato custard in a short pastry case, a Southern family dessert. Mash 500g cooked sweet potato with 150g brown sugar, 2 eggs, 200ml evaporated milk, cinnamon and nutmeg.
K: Strong black tea sweetened while hot and poured over lots of ice with lemon.

s.how: Simmer 500g raw peanuts in the shell in 3L water with 80g salt for 3 hours until soft. Drain and serve warm. Serve straight away on a big platter in the middle of the table.

s.note: Dewey's first gigs in the fifties
s.how: Bake 1kg frozen shoestring fries at 220C for 20 minutes. Melt 20g butter, stir in 1 tbsp flour and 250ml milk until thick, then 150g grated cheddar. Pour over the fries and scatter with sliced spring onion.

m.how: Soak 1.2kg chicken pieces in 300ml buttermilk overnight. Dredge in 200g flour with paprika and salt and fry at 165C for 14 minutes. Serve with 800g mashed potatoes and gravy.

w.how: Mash 500g cooked sweet potato with 150g brown sugar, 2 eggs, 200ml evaporated milk, cinnamon and nutmeg. Pour into a blind-baked 23cm pastry case and bake at 175C for 45 minutes.

d.how: Brew 6 black tea bags in 1L boiling water for 5 minutes, stir in 120g sugar and cool. Serve over ice with lemon. Make it just before the film starts and keep the jug cold.
